arm_order: Use the unchanged original rubric arm_order
primary_measures: Frozen exact-source material checks banked at the common physical ceiling
Actual model HTTP attempts, known tokens, unknown usage, tool errors and forced review requests
Unassessed/adequate/stale target state, deferred material and actual execution stop reason
Exact original bodies, passage coordinates, rule-date lineage and unknown-boundary preservation
review_rules: Use concurrent V2 rather than historical V2 as the main control; historical samples are diagnostic only
Inspect every raw request and response, not counters alone
Retain transport failures and censored arms; do not treat them as zero quality
Deferred/unreviewed candidates are recall limitations, never completed evidence
A new assessment schema can reject introduced dates; inspect whether a rejected date is an observation query or an unsupported eligibility boundary
Report source-specific rubric misses separately from useful alternative-source material
The unchanged analysis projection is an offline visibility measurement, not an analysis model run
No automatic redispatch, model switch, quota restart, budget increase, duplicate worker, or production promotion
next_gate: Consider an untouched pilot only after useful material retention is maintained or improved at lower measured cost, with no evidence loss or unresolved integrity defect. These five repaired cases cannot demonstrate generalization.
temporal_scope: Retrospective unrestricted current captures; not a cutoff-safe forecast
